contributions.detail: TWO Schedule A sheets, 29 rows. Sheet 1 (p2, foliated 'Page 2', all 15 printed rows used): 100 + 200 + 100 + 100 + 100 + 20 + 500 + 100 + 50 + 25 + 100 + 250 + 50 + 7 + 10 = 1,712.00 = that sheet's printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 1,712.00'. Sheet 2 (p3, foliated 'Page 3', 14 rows): 20 + 100 + 50 + 50 + 100 + 200 + 50 + 200 + 65 + 5 + 50 + 100 + 100 + 7,819.38 = 8,909.38 = its printed subtotal. 1,712.00 + 8,909.38 = 10,621.38 exactly = the printed Total Contributions Received = Box B. The 7,819.38 candidate LOAN is inside that anchor and is therefore published as a contribution row. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints the SAME 10,621.38 (this is the filer's first report of the cycle, so period = year-to-date) and is still never summed as an increment. The ladder closes on the page: Box A $0.00 + Box B 10,621.38 = Box F 10,621.38, minus Box D 10,621.38 = the printed close $0.00.

in_kind_convention: monetary-only, and TESTED FROM SCRATCH ON THIS FILING rather than inherited (ADDENDUM G1). notes: modern_boxAF, revision 'v. 4.20' (footer). 6 pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover ('Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates'), p2 and p3 SCHEDULE A sheets 1 and 2, p4 and p5 SCHEDULE B sheets 1 and 2, p6 SUMMARY PAGE (LAST, located by its heading). Foliation is CONTINUOUS ACROSS THE DOCUMENT (Page 1..6), the same practice as this filer's other 2020 filing and different from the per-schedule foliation on the Ivie filings in this chunk. Page-face candidate 'Brian Voeks' matches the channel label and the page-face office 'Utah County Recorder' agrees with index.csv. Report type: 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' (single radio); amendment ticked 'No'; signature date and Date of Report both 'June 22, 2020' while the channel labels the reporting period 'Primary' - consistent, and the page face governs. REDACTION, and it is the OPPOSITE of this filer's July filing: here the county blacked out the STREET portion of EVERY donor address on both Schedule A sheets, leaving city/state/zip in the clear, and also blacked out the cover signature; on his 9 July filing (e5b86de6) the same clerk published every donor address whole. Same filer, same cycle, same form, two redaction practices - so redaction is judged per document and per cell, never from the filename (both files here are named '_Redacted'). The bars sit wholly inside the address column and touch no name, date or figure. This filing's single largest contribution is the candidate's own 7,819.38 LOAN, which the ladder places inside Box B and which is therefore published as a contribution row; and Box B equals Box D exactly, so the period closes at zero - the filer's own arithmetic, transcribed as printed and not adjudicated.
